name: Plastics Plus
old_description: Since 1998, we have specialized in custom plastic fabrication, along with offering a large variety of standard sized acrylic sign holders, and a variety of other standard products. If you do not find a style or a size that will satisfy your needs already on our website, we would be happy to work with you to create a custom design. Custom design options are available to you on all of our products including ballot boxes, donation boxes, business card holders, and risers, and custom designs do not have to be expensive. We will work to find the most cost effective way to meet your display needs, and our estimates are always free.
about:
Plastics Plus operates from Bismarck, North Dakota, where it was founded in January 1998 by a hobby woodworker who needed a small piece of Plexiglas for a project. The company has since grown into a manufacturer of custom plastic fabrications and standard acrylic displays, selling across the United States and Canada.

The company fabricates items from acrylic, polycarbonate, PVC, PETG, ABS, and HDPE, offering both custom designs and a catalog of over 1,000 standard products including sign holders, brochure holders, risers, ballot boxes, donation boxes, business card holders, and outdoor weather‑resistant displays. Its Bismarck facility handles orders ranging from a few pieces to several thousand units, with cut‑to‑size sheet stock also available.

Plastics Plus serves businesses, organizations, and individuals in healthcare (hospitals and clinics use chart holders and bio card holders), retail and marketing (point‑of‑purchase signage, trade‑show displays), funeral homes, construction (window well covers), and safety (glove box holders). Government and civic customers purchase ballot boxes, while distributors benefit from blind‑shipping and multi‑location fulfillment.

The founder’s original need for a single plastic piece shaped a culture of no minimum orders, no broken‑case fees, and free estimates on custom work. The company emphasizes made‑in‑America production — virtually all items are fabricated in‑house — along with fast turnaround times and personal customer service as its primary differentiators.
